subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should Gateway own when a configured channel fails before channel registration?
rationale: The remaining fix can be warn-and-continue audit logging, fail-fast compatibility gating, explicit doctor/install recovery, or separate reload/performance work; repository policy also treats plugin metadata as process-stable unless an owner reload/install/doctor flow exists.

options.title: Adopt narrow audit contract
options.body: Keep Gateway startup running but emit a structured warning/audit for configured channels that fail before registration, with doctor/install guidance and separate trackers for hot reload and performance caching.

options.title: Fail fast for configured-channel incompatibility
options.body: Stop Gateway startup when a configured channel plugin is incompatible or missing, trading stronger visibility for a higher upgrade-compatibility risk.

options.title: Split and close only covered slices
options.body: Treat #96397, #86039, and #91873 as narrow trackers and leave this issue open only for the unowned startup audit and health-warning contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrow audit contract
recommendation.body: Keep Gateway startup running but emit a structured warning/audit for configured channels that fail before registration, with doctor/install guidance and separate trackers for hot reload and performance caching.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is centered on plugin activation, trust, and Gateway startup policy, where #59844 provides relevant ownership history.
